changes.summary: The home page headline now reads "Nine divisions. One champ." instead of stopping at "One."
The home page headline now reads "Two conferences. One champ." instead of stopping at "One."
Schefter can no longer use another league's name in AFL news, chat posts or notifications; the Week 5 Gauntlet headline now says the AFL.
Schefter's trade speculation no longer calls two teams division rivals unless they actually share a division.
AFL Rosters on a phone: position headers span the full card again, and the sort chips scroll inside it and read like TheLeague's ("Pts ↓").
Rosters on a phone now show player cards instead of a sideways-scrolling table, the same as the AFL.
Transactions is now Schefter's wire: every move gets his write-up, with the official record under See details, and past seasons tucked in a menu.
changes.headline: Schefter now reports every move
changes.lede: The Transactions page leads with Claude Schefter's take on each pickup, cut and trade this season. Tap See details for MFL's official record.
changes.imageAlt: The Transactions page showing Schefter's write-ups of the day's pickups, one opened to show the official record

changes.summary: Teams you've ranked on your Owners' Poll ballot keep their record, points and all-play next to them, so reordering never means scrolling back to compare.
